title: Quantum Projection: amplitude-encoded statevectors projected onto a stored subspace (SYNTHETIC classical emulation)
description:
SYNTHETIC. Standard-library Python classical emulation of quantum kinematics: amplitude-encoded statevectors stored in a complex outer-product memory, overlap-based projection onto the stored subspace, and lossy Haar coarse-graining (equivalent to projecting one qubit onto |+>). With orthonormal patterns the memory is a projector and recall reaches its fixed point in one step, with recalled fidelity equal to the Born weight; with non-orthogonal patterns repeated recall drifts to the dominant eigenvector. Includes 200-seed sweeps with unstored and random controls. No speedup, no Bell violation, no hardware data.
